title: Steps and photos
intro: Step-by-step forms (a bar of named steps, dots for steps that depend on answers), a record whose sections are workflow steps, and the photo viewer.
stepFormsHint: Both keep a draft: fill a step, reload the page and open them again. The lead's last step refuses taken{'@'}example.com the way a server would.
leadSub: Three named steps with a bar, in a dialog
entrySub: Dots: the number of steps follows the answers (a VIN ending in an odd digit asks for a version)
appraisalSub: Sections as workflow steps, each saying where it stands
photosSub: A gallery and a picture field opening the viewer

lead.title: New lead

photos.title: Photographs
photos.intro: Tap a picture to open the viewer: zoom with the wheel, a double tap or a pinch, drag when zoomed, swipe or use the arrow keys between pictures.
photos.fieldHint: Tap the picture in the form to look at it closer.
